initialContext.description: The initial context to pass to the (first) callback.

batchSize.description: The number of results to pass to the callback in each call.

callback.description:
The callback which processes the batches of results.
Each call of the callback will be made with an array of one or
more results, up to the number specified by {@link #batchSize}.

State can be carried between callbacks via the context parameter.
The {@link #initialContext} value is passed to the first callback
and each callback's return value is passed to the next callback.

The final callback's return value is returned by {@link Batch#scanResult}.
